**Texere 0.4.3** · 11 November 2026

Texere works from the first start, in a new vault and in one you already have.

- **Citations work at once.** No more "Citations and the bibliography don't work … isn't there anymore" on a new vault: Texere adds an empty bibliography and six citation styles (APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard, IEEE) in **Support/Texere/Bibliography** if they were never there. Another plugin's bibliography (e.g. BibLib) is left alone.
- **No false alarms.** A folder that was never in your vault is created when it's first needed; only one that was there and disappeared shows **Put it back** or **Choose…**. Until Texere is set up, the home page shows just **Set up**.
- **New vault:** the setup proposes the Texere structure (the one in the ready-made vault), the home page opens in the new tab and the Texere icon comes first in the ribbon.
- **A vault you already have:** **My own folders** is selected, so you choose where reading notes, PDFs and exports go; Texere moves nothing and leaves your ribbon and sidebar as they are.

Also in this version (from 0.4.2): no more stutter every second with the Zotero button on; `@` citations forgive typos (`@ascombe` finds Anscombe) and show your newest references first; Distil shows an annotation's printed page; a pasted APA book citation is read as a book.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
